name: No MPC or multi-sig on hot wallets
description: Hot wallets controlled by a single key; key compromise = total loss.

name: Insufficient cold-storage segregation
description: Bulk of customer assets sit on hot wallets rather than offline cold storage.

name: No formal key generation / rotation ceremony
description: No documented multi-party key ceremony, no rotation cadence.

name: No on-chain analytics / screening
description: Inbound and outbound addresses not screened against sanctions, mixers, or darknet labels.

name: Stale or no sanctions-list feed
description: Sanctions screening relies on infrequently updated lists.

name: No behavioural transaction monitoring rules
description: No rules for layering, peeling chains, structuring, or unusual velocity.

name: No source-of-funds / source-of-wealth procedure
description: No documented threshold-based SoF/SoW evidence collection.

name: No enhanced due diligence trigger policy
description: PEP, high-risk-jurisdiction, complex-ownership customers handled the same as standard ones.

name: No travel-rule protocol implementation
description: Outbound transfers to other VASPs do not include required originator/beneficiary data exchange.

name: No trade surveillance
description: No automated detection of wash-trading, spoofing, or insider activity on listed tokens.

name: No deposit / withdrawal velocity limits
description: New customers can deposit fiat and withdraw crypto in minutes with no caps.

name: No deposit aging before crypto withdrawal
description: Fiat deposits available for crypto conversion immediately, before chargeback window closes.

name: No 3DS / strong customer auth on card deposits
description: Card deposits accepted without SCA, raising chargeback fraud rates.

name: No pre-listing due diligence framework
description: Tokens listed without legal opinion, smart-contract audit, or issuer KYC.

name: Listed tokens lack smart-contract audit
description: No requirement for an independent audit on contracts you list.
